class.name: GameplayUserSession
class.brief_description: Stable server-side user session that can move between transport peers.
class.description: GameplayUserSession owns the preserved [GameplayPlayerState] and [GameplayController] during the disconnect grace period. Its peer ID is temporary; its user ID, session ID, and reconnect token are stable. Treat reconnect tokens as secrets and do not log or replicate them.

method.name: get_disconnected_at_msec
method.description: Returns the monotonic disconnect timestamp, or [code]0[/code] while active.

method.name: get_reconnect_token
method.description: Returns the opaque reconnect credential. Server code should keep this value private.

members.member: Whether a transport peer is currently bound.
The preserved controller after player creation.
The current peer ID, or [code]0[/code] while disconnected.

signal.name: deactivated
signal.description: Emitted when the transport binding is removed.

signal.name: peer_bound
signal.description: Emitted after an initial bind or reconnect.
